en: The Triplet of the Wholesome (Kusalattika), The Triplet of Having the Past as Object (Atītārammaṇattika)
Dependent on a wholesome state with a past object, there arises a non-wholesome state that does not have a past object by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Nine under root; nine under predominance … pe … three under mutuality … pe … three under result … pe … nine under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a wholesome state with a future object, there arises a non-wholesome state that does not have a future object by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine under root; nine under predominance … pe … nine under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a wholesome state with a present object, there arises a not-wholesome state that does not have a present object by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Nine under root; nine under predominance … pe … three under mutuality … pe … three under result … pe … nine under non-disappearance.
